review_groups.detail: result_issued denotes the owner's committed frozen result, not measured caller receipt. Public bootstrap finalize accepts only incomplete; normal consistent/negative completion derives from controller-owned gates. Cached finalized state rejects later misuse without clock/error/counter/I/O mutation. Existing emit permits the in-flight postseal veto before final acknowledgment.

File close observation is explicitly derived from the raw signed32 CloseHandle scalar, independently of wrapper return. Nonzero scalar followed by wrapper failure stays known closed/once-consumed; unobserved remains null/unknown. Monotonic wrapper and raw-count facts remain separate.

Serialized rows have seven immutable keys and no own state/return/ACK. Registry observations may update after append without changing bytes. Callback defaults distinguish unprepared0/null, prepared-undispatched payload and returned/foreign/unknown ACK. Journal close consumes the no-more-append right before dispatch even when ACK is unknown; tip requires all known row ACKs and close ACK.

Finite diagnostic phases, exact read-only FileRecordRef/CallRef/BufferRef surfaces and canonical identity comparisons are declared. Immutable diagnostic token/text is separate from original exception getters. No copied fields, token or ready bool grants authority.

Integer counters/IDs/lengths reject bool/coercion and oversized conversions; flags are exact bool, times finite nonbool original-clock samples. Compact publication packets have exactly11keys/8totals keys, no raw ledger/paths/selfhash, and only earlier acknowledged links. Five kinds stay once-attempted/<=8192; no new public publication method is introduced.
